title: The key is handed to the Guru
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 204
summary: The shabad opens with an honest plea for the saint who can show the way to the Lord. It travels through ego's curtain, Maya's sleep, and the hidden substance within, before coming to rest in the Guru holding the key.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person who knows effort alone is not getting them home. Held patiently, it changes spiritual frustration into a truer dependence on the Guru and the company of the holy.
takeaway: Ask for the guidance that can lead you through ego's curtain.

lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kin bidh milai gusaiee mere raam rai ||
lines.translation: How may I meet my Master, the King, the Lord of the Universe?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੇਇ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: koiee aaisaa sa(n)t sahaj sukhadhaataa moh maarag dhei bataiee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Is there any Saint, who can bestow such celestial peace, and show me the Way to Him? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar alakh na jaiee lakhiaa vich paRadhaa haumai paiee ||
lines.translation: The Unseen Lord is deep within the self; He cannot be seen; the curtain of egotism intervenes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਭੋ ਜਗੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਇਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: maiaa moh sabho jag soiaa ih bharam kahahu kiau jaiee ||1||
lines.translation: In emotional attachment to Maya, all the world is asleep. Tell me, how can this doubt be dispelled? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਕਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਸਤੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਕਰਤੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekaa sa(n)gat ikat gireh basate mil baat na karate bhaiee ||
lines.translation: The one lives together with the other in the same house, but they do not talk to one another, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ ਓਹ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਠਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ek basat bin pa(n)ch dhuhele oh basat agochar Thaiee ||2||
lines.translation: Without the one substance, the five are miserable; that substance is in the unapproachable place. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤਾਲਾ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਉਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kaa girahu tin dheeaa taalaa ku(n)jee gur saupaiee ||
lines.translation: And the one whose home it is, has locked it up, and given the key to the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: anik upaav kare nahee paavai bin satigur saranaiee ||3||
lines.translation: You may make all sorts of efforts, but it cannot be obtained, without the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin ke ba(n)dhan kaaTe satigur tin saadhasa(n)gat liv laiee ||
lines.translation: Those whose bonds have been broken by the True Guru, enshrine love for the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch janaa mil ma(n)gal gaiaa har naanak bhedh na bhaiee ||4||
lines.translation: The self-elect, the self-realized beings, meet together and sing the joyous songs of the Lord. Nanak, there is no difference between them, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere raam rai in bidh milai gusaiee ||
lines.translation: This is how my Sovereign Lord King, the Lord of the Universe, is met;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਠਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੧੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj bhiaa bhram khin meh naaThaa mil jotee jot samaiee ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||1||122||
lines.translation: celestial bliss is attained in an instant, and doubt is dispelled. Meeting Him, my light merges in the Light. ||1||Second Pause||1||122||

structure: The shabad starts with a direct request for the saint who can show the way.
From there it explains why the Lord feels hidden: ego, Maya, and the misery of the five keep the house sealed.
The closing movement rests by placing the key with the Guru and joy with the company of the holy.
